assessments.summary: The supplied proof establishes exact additivity of the averaged separately-relaxed UV sum-rate functional for finite-alphabet product broadcast channels, including correlated product inputs and joint envelope auxiliaries. Receiver-skew symmetry equates the branchwise and averaged functionals and extends their additivity to finite products. Using the dependency’s BSSC inequality and contact identity, it also derives the exact half-skew BSSC value n(2h_2(1/4)-5/4) for every n>=1.
scopeQualifications: The result concerns only the two separately-relaxed scalar UV functionals defined in the contribution.
It does not establish tensorization of the full UV region, a common joint-(U,V) optimization, the GK functional, any broader converse system, or broadcast-channel capacity.
The BSSC specialization relies on the declared dependency for the supporting inequality and contact identity.
